fixes.text: "test (windows-latest, 3.15t, no-deprecation, highest, starlette-git)" runs 9 min in one job: shard it
Setup on the critical path: 3.3 min of setup in jobs that first wait on others; start it while they wait, and wait only for the step you need
Jobs wait 160 s for a runner at p90: GitHub-hosted runners are often slow to start, so price a faster provider
Cancel superseded PR runs: no concurrency with cancel-in-progress
